title: logast metrics.yaml
description: Optional. One entry per outcome the logs report and no metric counts; left blank, no metric is added. Then run logast apply .

count.description: counter: Outcomes.count(name, outcome), a counter name{outcome=…}; tag: Outcomes.tag(outcome) on the timer already running (only where _tag says available); skip: never offered again (a // logast:ignore comment); empty: undecided

name.description: The metric name: lower case, dots

amount.description: Where the line logs a number (_amounts): the one to count too; empty: count how often only

as.description: total: a counter name.<amount> grows by it; per-run: each value one sample of a distribution summary; empty: metrics.amounts from logast.yaml

^_.description: A hint logast writes (keys starting with _): keep it, logast finds the line again with it
